title: Fix VSCode Launch Configs
description: Fix incorrect VSCode launch.json and tasks.json configs: wrong repo/vscode dev task type/path, wrong nx project paths for compose/logo (assets/logo), compose/icons (assets/icons), compose/net (net/Compose), remove non-existent grasshopper/yak projects, add missing compose/sketchpad.
summary: Fixed incorrect VSCode launch.json and tasks.json configs: fixed repo/vscode dev task from npm type with wrong path js/vscode to shell npx nx dev repo; fixed nx project refs for compose/logo (@semio-tech/compose-logo, root at compose/assets/logo), compose/icons (@semio-tech/compose-icons, root at compose/assets/icons), compose/net (@semio-tech/compose-net, root at compose/net/Compose); removed non-existent compose/grasshopper and compose/yak projects; added missing compose/sketchpad (build, preflight, dev, publish) configs.
